- 🔑 THE ERROR SPLIT IS THE DESIGN DECISION: a missing kind is a wiring bug that must be loud, an absent entity is an ordinary 404. Collapsing them would make a typo'd kind look like a deleted row
- the snapshot cap truncates with a VISIBLE notice line rather than silently — a truncated context the model cannot tell is truncated is worse than a short one
- tests/test_investigate.py 36/36

**Notes:** The registry's shape is what makes the rest of the plan possible: the owning module registers a pure-read function, so core never learns thirteen stores. It also means the trust boundary is one function signature wide.
